visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a mirror reflection of a young woman wearing a black beanie and a grey leather jacket over a grey top. She stands against a dark, textured wall with the white text 'DON'T LOOK UP' visible above a circular mirror. A large pink '520' graphic is overlaid on the left side of the frame. (2) A close-up shot features a hand holding two vertical photo strips against a vibrant red background. Each strip contains four separate photos showing the woman posing with a G-Dragon graphic. The logo 'Ubermensch' is printed at the top of the photo strips. (3) The woman is filmed from a low angle as she excitedly enters a modern facility. She is wearing her black beanie and grey jacket, looking directly into the camera with a joyful expression. The background shows an urban indoor environment with clean white walls and bright studio lighting. (4) The woman performs an outfit check in a spacious indoor hallway. She is wearing a black beanie, a grey cropped jacket, a grey top, and black flared trousers with a white cloth wrap around her waist. She turns and poses to show her full attire while carrying a black textured handbag. (5) In a hallway with blue neon 'X' lights on the ceiling, the woman dances and walks toward a photo booth. The walls are dark grey and feature 'DON'T LOOK UP' signage. She moves with high energy, smiling and looking playfully at the camera. (6) A series of top-down photo booth shots are shown. The woman poses in a small room with changing background colors: red, then purple, then dark green. She interacts with a digital G-Dragon figure, making peace signs and hearts. (7) The camera focuses on a black metal photo booth machine as the printed photo strips emerge from a slot. The lighting is focused and warm, highlighting the texture of the machine and the freshly printed images. (8) The final shot shows the woman posing against a light grey wall next to a pink door. She holds her black handbag over her shoulder and makes a peace sign. A large pink '520' graphic appears on the screen as the video concludes.
